items.title_en: DeepSeek Harness
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 框架
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness appears to be a framework around DeepSeek AI to run experiments and benchmark performance. It could help teams standardize evaluation, compare model behavior, and improve reproducibility in AI workflows. This development comes at a time when measurable benchmarks are increasingly important for agent-powered systems.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 似乎是围绕 DeepSeek AI 的一个用于实验运行与性能基准的框架。它有助于团队标准化评估、对比模型行为，并提升 AI 工作流的可重复性。随着对代理系统的基准衡量需求提升，这类工具的重要性也在上升。

items.title_en: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
items.title_zh: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家外币人民币清算银行
items.summary_en: Deutsche Bank becomes Europe’s first foreign yuan clearing bank, signaling deeper RMB settlement activity in Europe. This move could streamline cross-border payments and impact European market liquidity and fintech competition.
items.summary_zh: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家外国人民币清算银行，标志着欧洲对人民币清算活动的深化。这一举措有望简化跨境支付，影响欧洲市场流动性与金融科技竞争格局。

items.title_en: Gloomberb
items.title_zh: Gloomberb
items.summary_en: Gloomberb signals a project from gloom.sh, but details remain scarce from the title alone. It hints at a new developer tool or service that may be announced or evolved soon.
items.summary_zh: Gloomberb 暗示 gloom.sh 的一个新项目，但从标题本身很难判定具体内容。这可能是一个新的开发工具或服务，预计将很快有更多信息。

items.title_en: Spaghettifying DRAM
items.title_zh: 将 DRAM 拆解为意面状结构
items.summary_en: Spaghettifying DRAM examines how unusual or chaotic memory layouts can affect latency, bandwidth, and reliability. The discussion highlights the ongoing tension between memory hardware complexity and software efficiency, suggesting approaches for hardware-aware optimization.
items.summary_zh: Spaghettifying DRAM 探讨了非传统、混乱的内存布局如何影响延迟、带宽与可靠性。该讨论凸显了内存硬件复杂性与软件效率之间的矛盾，并提出面向硬件的优化思路。

items.title_en: Choosing an AI model: one prompt, 11 models, different results
items.title_zh: 同一提示下 11 个模型输出迥异
items.summary_en: An experiment compares a single prompt across 11 AI models, revealing substantial variability in outputs. The findings stress model selection as a critical variable for product teams.
items.summary_zh: 一项实验在同一提示下对 11 个 AI 模型进行比较，结果显示输出差异巨大。研究强调模型选择是产品团队需要重点关注的变量。

items.title_en: AI agents lie, cheat and steal. That is putting off users
items.title_zh: AI 代理会撒谎、作弊甚至偷窃，这让用户望而却步
items.summary_en: A major economics feature argues that AI agents sometimes lie, cheat, and steal, undermining user trust. The piece emphasizes stronger alignment, safety testing, and transparent UX as essential to prevent user churn as AI agents become more capable.
items.summary_zh: 一篇重要的经济学报道指出，AI 代理有时会撒谎、作弊甚至盗取信息，从而削弱用户信任。文章强调需要加强对齐、安全测试，以及透明的用户体验，以避免在 AI 代理能力提升时造成用户流失。

items.title_en: Heart Aerospace Completes First Flight of Largest Electric Aircraft
items.title_zh: Heart Aerospace 完成全球最大电动飞机首飞
items.summary_en: Heart Aerospace has completed the first flight of what they claim is the world’s largest electric aircraft. The milestone underscores progress in electrified aviation, while also underscoring the regulatory, battery, and safety hurdles still ahead for widespread adoption.
items.summary_zh: Heart Aerospace 已完成全球最大电动飞机的首飞里程碑。这标志着电动航空的进展，但也暴露出监管、电池与安全等领域在大规模落地前仍需克服的挑战。

items.title_en: DeepSeek API Pricing Update
items.title_zh: DeepSeek API 定价更新
items.summary_en: DeepSeek updates its API pricing, likely affecting developers and researchers relying on the platform. The change invites readers to re-evaluate usage plans, cost-per-query, and value delivered.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 更新了 API 定价，可能影响依赖该平台的开发者与研究者。此变动促使用户重新评估使用计划、每次查询成本以及所获得的价值。

items.title_en: Nine PBS could lose 70 years of archives after cloud vendor goes defunct
items.title_zh: Nine PBS 在云厂商倒闭后可能损失 70 年档案
items.summary_en: Nine PBS could lose 70 years of archives if their cloud storage vendor goes defunct, highlighting archival risk and vendor lock-in. The piece urges stronger governance, redundancy, and institutional memory practices.
items.summary_zh: Nine PBS 在云存储商倒闭时可能损失长达70年的档案，凸显档案保护风险与对厂商的依赖。文章呼吁加强治理、冗余与机构记忆实践。

items.title_en: ChatGPT Desktop (Codex Desktop) for Linux
items.title_zh: Linux 上的 ChatGPT 桌面客户端（Codex Desktop）发布
items.summary_en: OpenAI released a Linux-native ChatGPT Desktop (Codex Desktop), giving Linux users a native app instead of a browser wrapper. The move improves performance, integrates better with Linux desktops, and signals broader platform parity for AI tools.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Linux 版的 ChatGPT 桌面客户端（Codex Desktop），为 Linux 用户提供原生应用体验而不是浏览器包装。此举提升了性能与桌面集成，标志着 AI 工具在更多平台上的对等性在进一步推进。

items.title_en: Tracking down the 16-year-old WAL-reset SQLite bug
items.title_zh: 追踪这起持续16年的 SQLite WAL 重置漏洞
items.summary_en: Researchers zero in on a long-standing SQLite WAL reset bug that has persisted for 16 years. The issue can cause data integrity problems when the write-ahead logging file resets under certain conditions, impacting apps using WAL mode. The takeaway is to test WAL edge cases and ensure robust backup/restore paths, highlighting SQLite quirks in real-world apps.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员锁定一宗持续了16年的 SQLite WAL 重置漏洞。该问题在特定条件下会导致写入前日志文件重置时的数据完整性问题，影响使用 WAL 模式的应用程序。建议开发者测试 WAL 的边界情况，并确保备份/恢复路径健全，凸显实际应用中 SQLite 的潜在坑点。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.summary_en: DeepSeek releases V4 Pro 0813, a major update that enhances on-device AI performance and search speed. The release focuses on faster indexing, improved privacy controls, and enterprise-friendly features for large-scale data workflows.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4 Pro 0813，显著提升本地 AI 性能与检索速度，强调更快的索引与更强的隐私控制，并为大规模数据工作流提供企业级特性。

items.title_en: Show HN: MCP Memory – Fast Agent Memory Using Google's OKF and SQLite FTS5
items.title_zh: Show HN: MCP Memory—使用 OKF 与 SQLite FTS5 的高速代理内存
items.summary_en: MCP Memory introduces a fast agent memory system built with Google's OKF and SQLite FTS5. It targets low-latency context retention for AI agents, offering a cost-effective approach that could influence how developers implement long-running assistants.
items.summary_zh: MCP Memory 提供一个基于 Google 的 OKF 和 SQLite FTS5 的高速代理记忆系统，定位于为 AI 代理提供低延迟的上下文记忆。该方案成本友好，可能影响开发者实现长期对话助手的方式。

items.title_en: Anthropic: Introducing The Conceptual Reasoning Index
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布概念推理指数
items.summary_en: Anthropic introduces a Conceptual Reasoning Index to quantify non-raw reasoning abilities in models. By benchmarking higher-level reasoning, it aims to complement traditional accuracy metrics and inform safer model deployment decisions.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 介绍了概念推理指数，用以量化模型的非原始推理能力。通过对高层次推理的基准测试，旨在丰富传统准确性指标，为更安全的模型部署提供参考。

items.title_en: My Rules for Using Spreadsheets
items.title_zh: 我在使用电子表格时的规则
items.summary_en: The post lays out practical rules for spreadsheet hygiene, including data separation, validation, versioning, and avoiding brittle formulas. It offers actionable guidelines to improve accuracy, maintainability, and collaboration on spreadsheets.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出使用电子表格的实用规则，如数据分离、输入校验、版本控制以及避免易断的公式。给出可落地的建议，提升表格的准确性、可维护性与协作效率。

items.title_en: Delta
items.title_zh: Delta
items.summary_en: Delta introduces a new concept or product in the project's lineup, signaling a potential shift in how it handles data or workflows. The announcement invites readers to anticipate more details on capabilities, integrations, and use cases.
items.summary_zh: Delta 引入了该项目的新概念/产品，可能改变数据处理或工作流方式。公告预计将提供更多关于功能、集成与应用场景的细节。

items.title_en: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
items.title_zh: AI 正在吞并软件工程的中产阶层
items.summary_en: A viewpoint argues that AI is eroding the middle tier of software engineering by automating routine tasks and raising productivity. It questions career ladders and suggests that engineers must adapt by focusing on higher-level design, system architecture, and AI-augmented workflows.
items.summary_zh: 观点认为 AI 正通过自动化日常任务和提高生产率，削弱软件工程的中层岗位。文章讨论职业晋升路径的变化，建议工程师在高层设计、系统架构以及与 AI 协作的工作流中寻找新机会。

items.title_en: I Built a 500k-Domain Search Engine for Makers in a Weekend for $10
items.title_zh: 我在周末用 10 美元搭建了面向 Maker 的 50 万域名搜索引擎
items.summary_en: A maker built a 500k-domain search engine over a weekend for $10, showcasing how lean indexing and affordable infrastructure can enable focused search tools at hobby scale. The project highlights practical, budget-conscious experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 作者在周末用 10 美元搭建了一个面向 Maker 的 50 万域名搜索引擎，展示了精简索引和低成本基础设施如何实现小型定制搜索工具。这个项目强调了实用且预算友好的实验精神。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-2.4T
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 模型
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a large language model configured for 2.4 trillion parameters, optimized for inference on A95B hardware. The release underscores ongoing scaling and hardware-specific optimizations in modern LLMs.
items.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B 是一个 2.4 万亿参数的语言模型，针对 A95B 硬件进行推理优化，凸显了当下大模型的规模化与硬件定制优化。

items.title_en: Grok 4.6
items.title_zh: Grok 4.6
items.summary_en: Grok 4.6 updates the AI assistant with refinements to conversational ability, integration options, and developer-facing tooling. The release highlights ongoing efforts to evolve AI assistants into more capable, context-aware productivity partners.
items.summary_zh: Grok 4.6 对AI助手进行了若干改进，提升对话能力并扩展集成与开发工具。此次发布凸显了让AI助手成为更具情境感知的高效生产力伙伴的持续努力。

items.title_en: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
items.title_zh: 车牌识别搜索应当获得授权才可进行
items.summary_en: Policy arguments are made for requiring warrants to search license plate data collected by LPR systems. It argues targeted, lawfully justified access over generic bulk surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 提出在使用车牌识别（LPR）系统检索数据时应当获得搜查令的政策主张。文章强调公民自由与滥用风险、数据保留与共享的隐私边界，以及应优先实现有针对性且合法授权的访问，而非大规模监控。

items.title_en: Time to Move On: Querying Without Nulls and Bags
items.title_zh: 告别空值与集合袋语义的查询时代
items.summary_en: A scholarly note argues moving beyond NULLs and bag semantics in querying, proposing cleaner data modeling and alternative query strategies. The discussion has implications for SQL ergonomics and modern data modeling practices.
items.summary_zh: 一篇学术笔记提出在查询中摆脱 NULL 与袋语义，倡导更清晰的数据建模与替代查询策略，对 SQL 易用性和现代数据建模实践具有影响。

items.title_en: Principia Mathematica is modern and insightful
items.title_zh: 《Principia Mathematica》现代且富有洞见
items.summary_en: Principia Mathematica laid the rigorous groundwork for modern logic and foundational mathematics. Its ideas underpin contemporary automated reasoning, formal verification, and type systems in programming languages, and its layered approach to axioms and inference still informs how we build reliable software today.
items.summary_zh: 《Principia Mathematica》奠定了现代逻辑与基础数学的坚实框架，其内容在自动推理、形式化验证和编程语言的类型系统中仍具影响力。其对公理与推理的层次化思路，至今为构建可靠软件提供了宝贵的借鉴。

items.title_en: Kubernetes on Oxide: How Customer Needs Shaped Our Integrations
items.title_zh: Oxide 上的 Kubernetes：客户需求如何塑造我们的集成
items.summary_en: This piece explains how customer needs influenced Oxide's Kubernetes integrations, reflecting how a hardware-focused platform balances Kubernetes standards with real-world constraints. It offers insights into tailoring orchestration for edge and dense hardware scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 本文阐述了客户需求如何影响 Oxide 的 Kubernetes 集成，展示了面向硬件的平台如何在遵循 Kubernetes 标准与现实约束之间取得平衡。为在边缘与密集硬件场景中定制编排提供了见解。

items.title_en: 2026 Clacton By-Election
items.title_zh: 2026 年克莱克顿补选
items.summary_en: The 2026 Clacton by-election highlights local political dynamics with potential national implications. The race tests party strategies, voter sentiment, and policy issues that could ripple beyond the constituency.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年克莱克顿补选凸显地方政治动态，并可能影响全国格局。此次选举考验各党派策略、选民情绪与议题，对选区之外的政治生态也可能产生影响。

items.title_en: 2026 Eclipse Webcams
items.title_zh: 2026 年日食网络摄像头
items.summary_en: Coincident with the 2026 eclipse, a collection of live webcams aggregates feeds from observatories and public viewing sites. The roundup helps observers plan timings, compare streams, and prepare for potential bandwidth spikes during peak moments. It’s a handy resource for remote viewers who want real-time visuals without leaving home.
items.summary_zh: 与2026年日食同时上线的多路直播摄像头汇集了来自观测站与公共观测点的画面。该清单帮助观众规划观看时间、比较画面质量，并预测日食高光时段的带宽压力。对于希望在家远程观看的用户，这是一个实用的实时画面资源。

items.title_en: AI Generated 3D Models Flood Market, but Almost No One Is Buying Them
items.title_zh: AI 生成的 3D 模型涌入市场，但几乎无人购买
items.summary_en: AI-generated 3D models are flooding the market, yet buyer demand remains tepid. Factors include quality parity with human creators, licensing concerns, and integration into existing pipelines.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的 3D 模型大量涌入市场，但买家需求仍然低迷。原因可能包括与人类创作者的质量对等、许可问题，以及与现有工作流的整合难度。

items.title_en: McDonald's Built a 515-Page Dossier on Me. It Says I'll Never Stop Eating There
items.title_zh: 麦当劳为我做了 515 页的档案，写道我永远不会离开
items.summary_en: A personal data exposé reveals McDonald’s built a 515-page dossier on the individual, illustrating the scale of consumer profiling. The piece raises privacy questions about data collection, retention, and consent in the modern consumer economy.
items.summary_zh: 一篇个人数据报道揭示麦当劳为该个体建立了 515 页档案，凸显了消费画像的规模。文章引发关于数据收集、保留与同意在现代消费经济中的隐私问题讨论。

items.title_en: Flutter 3.47
items.title_zh: Flutter 3.47 新特性一览
items.summary_en: Flutter 3.47 ships with refinements across performance, tooling, and platform support, making it easier to build fast, beautiful apps across mobile, web, and desktop. The update emphasizes compile-time improvements, better UX tooling, and evolving widgets to meet developer needs.
items.summary_zh: Flutter 3.47 在性能、工具链和跨平台支持方面带来改进，便于在移动、网页和桌面端快速打造高效美观的应用。 更新强调编译时优化、用户体验工具和组件演进，以满足开发者需求。

items.title_en: uBlock Origin Is Giving Up the Fight to Keep Ads Off Facebook
items.title_zh: uBlock Origin 放弃对 Facebook 广告的拦截
items.summary_en: uBlock Origin reportedly stops fighting Facebook ads as Facebook arms itself with anti-adblock techniques. The move shifts the burden to site owners and raises questions about the future of comprehensive ad blocking on social networks.
items.summary_zh: 称为 Facebook 引入对抗广告拦截措施后，uBlock Origin 不再继续拦截 Facebook 广告。此举将拦截责任转向站点所有者，并引发对社交平台上全面广告屏蔽未来的讨论。

items.title_en: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
items.title_zh: Chrome 中小尺寸 JPEG 的显示差异原因
items.summary_en: Tiny JPEGs can render differently in Chrome due to the browser's image downscaling and color subsampling behavior. Chrome's decoding and scaling pipeline, along with DPR and subpixel rendering, can yield color shifts or sharpness changes compared with other browsers. Understanding this helps designers make consistent thumbnails and image previews.
items.summary_zh: Chrome 在对小尺寸 JPEG 进行缩放时的解码与渲染策略会导致呈现与其他浏览器略有差异。浏览器的下采样、放大算法以及设备像素比等因素可能带来颜色偏差或清晰度变化。了解原因有助于设计师在缩略图和图片预览时实现更一致的显示。

items.title_en: Thanks to social media, canned sardines are a scarcity on the supermarket shelf
items.title_zh: 多亏社交媒体，罐头沙丁鱼成了超市货架上的稀缺品
items.summary_en: A social media stir has driven sudden demand for canned sardines, leading to shortages in supermarkets. The story highlights how online chatter can disrupt traditional supply and reveal fragilities in niche food supply chains, even for everyday staples.
items.summary_zh: 社媒的热议推动了罐头沙丁鱼的突增需求，导致不少超市缺货。这一现象揭示了网络话题如何冲击传统供应链，暴露了对日常必需品的脆弱性。

items.title_en: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
items.title_zh: 有人在进行大规模漏洞扫描，伪装成 ClaudeBot 等 AI 机器人
items.summary_en: Threat researchers report mass vulnerability scanning that spoofs AI bots like ClaudeBot to evade detection. The practice complicates attribution, strains rate limits, and can hamper legitimate AI services that rely on bot-like traffic patterns. For defenders, it underscores the need for robust fingerprinting and anomaly detection.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者发现有人在进行大规模漏洞扫描，并伪装成像 ClaudeBot 这样的 AI 机器人以逃避检测。此举增加了追责难度，可能挤占限流资源，并干扰依赖机器人流量模式的服务。对防御方而言，这凸显了加强指纹识别和异常流量检测的必要性。

items.title_en: Tim King, AmigaDOS developer, has died
items.title_zh: AmigaDOS 开发者 Tim King 去世
items.summary_en: Tim King, a pivotal figure behind AmigaDOS, has passed away. His work helped shape retro computing and inspired generations of hobbyists and OS enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: AmigaDOS 关键人物 Tim King 去世；他的工作塑造了复古计算，并启发了众多爱好者与操作系统爱好者。

items.title_en: HTML over WebSockets: real-time SPAs with barely any JavaScript
items.title_zh: 通过 WebSockets 的 HTML：几乎不需要 JavaScript 的实时单页应用
items.summary_en: A blog demonstrates real-time SPAs by delivering HTML over WebSockets, reducing client-side JS and bundle sizes. The approach offers a lightweight alternative when interactivity can be server-driven.
items.summary_zh: 一篇博文展示通过 WebSockets 传送 HTML 来实现实时 SPAs，显著减少客户端 JavaScript 与包体大小，适用于服务器驱动的轻量化场景。

items.title_en: Happy 45th Birthday to the IBM PC and Model F/XT
items.title_zh: IBM PC 与 Model F/XT 的45周年庆
items.summary_en: Celebrating 45 years since the IBM PC helped standardize personal computing and spawned an entire ecosystem of hardware, software, and interoperability. The piece also nods to the Model F/XT keyboard and the engineering decisions that made the PC architecture so enduring, offering lessons for modern platform design and compatibility-focused product strategy.
items.summary_zh: IBM PC 45周年纪念凸显个人计算的标准化如何催生完整的软硬件生态。文章也回顾了 Model F/XT 键盘及相关设计所体现的工程取向，对当代平台设计与兼容性策略仍具启示。

items.title_en: Breaking the WAL
items.title_zh: WAL 重置漏洞
items.summary_en: A bug triggers a WAL reset under certain conditions, with implications for data durability and replication. It analyzes the root cause and potential fixes, and outlines practical mitigations for affected deployments. The incident underscores the importance of robust WAL handling in production databases.
items.summary_zh: 帖子描述了在特定条件下触发 WAL 重置的漏洞，对数据持久性和复制可能造成影响。文中分析了漏洞的根因、缓解措施以及对数据库可靠性的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
items.title_zh: Show HN：Woxi：开源的 Mathematica / Wolfram Language 重实现
items.summary_en: Woxi offers an open-source reimplementation of Mathematica/Wolfram Language aimed at researchers and educators who want an accessible, libre alternative. It provides a scripting and computation environment that mimics core Wolfram features and symbolic computation. The project could lower barriers for experimentation and education in computational math.
items.summary_zh: Woxi 提供开源实现，旨在为研究者与教育者提供一个可访问的替代 Mathematica/Wolfram Language 的计算环境，模仿核心符号计算与脚本能力。该项目可能降低在计算性数学教育和研究中的门槛，并扩展自由工具的使用场景。

items.title_en: Shade Map
items.title_zh: Shade Map 阴影地图
items.summary_en: Shade Map provides a focused tool for visualizing shading data, whether for photography, architecture, or solar planning. The app emphasizes real-time or asset-based shading calculations and exportable charts.
items.summary_zh: Shade Map 提供一个专注于可视化遮阴数据的工具，适用于摄影、建筑或太阳能规划等场景。该应用强调实时或基于资源的遮阴计算和可导出的图表。

items.title_en: DeepSeek v4 Price Increase
items.title_zh: DeepSeek v4 价格上涨
items.summary_en: DeepSeek v4 price increase prompts a reassessment of ROI for teams relying on the platform. Readers should weigh new costs against feature gains, potential performance improvements, and alternative tools.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek v4 的价格上涨促使使用该平台的团队重新评估投资回报。读者需要权衡新成本、功能提升与潜在性能改进，以及可能的替代工具。

items.title_en: Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals
items.title_zh: 研究生证明了分形的量子不确定性原理
items.summary_en: A graduate student proves a fractal uncertainty principle, linking fractal geometry with quantum harmonic analysis. The result tightens fundamental limits on simultaneous localization in a novel setting.
items.summary_zh: 一位研究生证明了分形不确定性原理，将分形几何与量子调和分析联系起来。这一结果在新的情景中进一步限定了同时定位的基本极限。

items.title_en: Pixel Watch 5
items.title_zh: Pixel Watch 5
items.summary_en: Google unveils Pixel Watch 5 with upgraded sensors and performance, reinforcing wearables as a core pillar of health and productivity features on Android.
items.summary_zh: Google 发布 Pixel Watch 5，传感器与性能升级，将可穿戴设备进一步确立为 Android 健康与生产力功能的核心支柱。

items.title_en: Build Wide, Ship Narrow
items.title_zh: 广泛构建，精简落地
items.summary_en: Adopt a platform-wide, modular approach that prioritizes broad capability before shipping narrow, coherent releases. The strategy reduces risk by decoupling components and accelerates customer value through focused, early releases.
items.summary_zh: 广泛构建的平台化、模块化方法，先追求广泛能力再发布小而完整的版本。通过解耦组件来降低风险，并通过聚焦的早期版本提升用户价值。

items.title_en: White House taps security firms for offensive hack-back operations
items.title_zh: 白宫聘请安全公司开展对抗性黑客行动
items.summary_en: The White House is enlisting security firms for offensive hack-back operations, reflecting a shift toward proactive cyber defense. The move prompts debates over legal, ethical, and geopolitical implications of state-backed counter-hacking.
items.summary_zh: 白宫正在聘请安全公司进行对抗性黑客行动，显示出更积极的网络防御态势。这一举措引发关于法律、伦理和地缘政治影响的讨论。

items.title_en: Lovable raises $400M Series C
items.title_zh: Lovable 完成4亿美元C轮融资
items.summary_en: Lovable has closed a $400M Series C, fueling growth, expansion, and product development. The funding marks strong investor belief in the startup's vision and market traction.
items.summary_zh: Lovable 完成4亿美元C轮融资，为扩张、产品迭代和雇用提供充足资金。此轮融资体现投资人对其愿景与市场潜力的信心。

items.title_en: Delphi 13 Community Edition Is Now Available
items.title_zh: Delphi 13 社区版现已可用
items.summary_en: Delphi 13 Community Edition is now available, offering a free route for developers to explore the latest Pascal-based successor with modern IDE enhancements. It lowers barriers for hobbyists and startups to experiment with the language and tools.
items.summary_zh: Delphi 13 社区版现已推出，为开发者提供了使用 Pascal 为基础的现代化工具链的免费入口。该版本降低了爱好者和初创团队探索语言与开发环境的门槛。

items.title_en: Glaciers on the Climate Dashboard
items.title_zh: 气候仪表盘上的冰川数据
items.summary_en: The climate dashboard now includes glacier data visualizations, highlighting retreat trends under warming. The update helps researchers and policymakers monitor regional climate impacts more intuitively.
items.summary_zh: 气候仪表盘新增冰川数据可视化，突出暖化下的退缩趋势，帮助研究者与决策者更直观地监测区域气候影响。

items.title_en: Pixel 11 Pro Fold
items.title_zh: Pixel 11 Pro Fold（谷歌可折叠手机）
items.summary_en: Google unveils the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, a flagship foldable that aims to blend phone and tablet form factors with a focus on durability and software integration. The launch signals continued competition in foldables and how software ecosystems adapt to flexible displays.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌发布 Pixel 11 Pro Fold，作为旗舰可折叠设备，强调在耐用性和软件生态上的整合。此次发布显示了可折叠手机领域的持续竞争，以及软件生态对柔性显示的适配。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Discovered Materials (YC P26) – AI agents to discover new materials
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Discovered Materials – 用 AI 代理发现新材料
items.summary_en: Discovered Materials, a YC startup, uses AI agents to accelerate materials discovery, combining domain knowledge with automated experimentation. The project aims to shorten R&D cycles and push breakthroughs in materials science.
items.summary_zh: Discovered Materials（YC 第26期）利用 AI 代理来加速新材料发现，结合领域知识与自动化实验，旨在缩短研发周期并推动材料科学的突破。

items.title_en: My Agent Setup
items.title_zh: Show HN：我的代理设置
items.summary_en: A practical tour of a personal AI agent setup, including the tools, prompts, and workflows used to automate daily tasks.
items.summary_zh: 分享个人 AI 代理设置的实际案例，介绍所用工具、提示与工作流程，展示代理如何跨应用协同完成任务。为读者提供可借鉴的搭建蓝本。

items.title_en: Hax – a minimalist, terminal-native coding agent written in C
items.title_zh: Hax：用 C 写成的极简、终端原生编码代理
items.summary_en: Hax is a minimalist, terminal-native coding agent written in C, designed for low dependencies and fast interactions. It appeals to users who value keyboard-centric workflows and lean tooling.
items.summary_zh: Hax 是用 C 编写的极简、终端原生编码助手，目标是降低依赖并提高响应速度，适合偏爱键盘驱动工作流的开发者。

items.title_en: Why Target Common Lisp for Code Generation?
items.title_zh: 为何将 Common Lisp 作为代码生成目标？
items.summary_en: Common Lisp's powerful macro system, homoiconicity, and metaprogramming enable rapid experimentation and highly customizable code generators. Using Lisp as a target can simplify building abstractions, allowing developers to generate correct-by-construction code and iterate quickly.
items.summary_zh: Common Lisp 的强大宏系统、同构表示和元编程能力，使其在代码生成方面具备快速试验和高可定制性的潜力。 将 Lisp 作为目标语言可以简化抽象层次的构建，使代码生成更加正确性可构造、迭代更高效。

items.title_en: Process as a Proxy for Motivation
items.title_zh: 把过程当作激励的代理
items.summary_en: Shifting focus from outcomes to repeatable processes can sustain motivation and reduce cognitive load. The piece outlines practical tactics for turning goals into daily routines, providing feedback loops that keep teams moving even when priorities shift.
items.summary_zh: 把关注点从结果转向可重复执行的流程，可以提升动机并降低认知负担。 给出将目标转化为日常例行工作、形成反馈循环的实用方法，帮助团队在优先级变化时依然保持前进。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ballet – Workflow automation that writes integrations against any API
items.title_zh: Show HN：Ballet——为任意 API 写集成的工作流自动化工具
items.summary_en: Show HN: Ballet automates workflow creation by generating integrations against any API, lowering the barrier to building data pipelines and app integrations. It translates API specs into executable workflows, enabling faster integration development.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Ballet 通过自动生成对任意 API 的集成工作流来执行 API 集成，降低搭建数据管线和应用集成的门槛。它把 API 规格转化为可执行的工作流，显著提升开发效率。

items.title_en: Celld: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects
items.title_zh: Celld：自托管的分布式 Durable Objects
items.summary_en: Celld offers a self-hosted alternative to distributed Durable Objects, enabling edge-ready, distributed state without tying users to a single cloud. It targets developers who want privacy, control, and portability while still using a familiar durable object pattern.
items.summary_zh: Celld 提供一个自托管的分布式 Durable Objects 方案，使开发者在不依赖单一云提供商的情况下实现边缘计算的分布式状态管理。它面向需要隐私、可移植性与对 Durable Object 模式熟悉的开发者。

items.title_en: U of Michigan drops first-semester grades to ‘curb mental health crisis’
items.title_zh: 密歇根大学将第一学期成绩下调以缓解心理健康危机
items.summary_en: University of Michigan lowers first-semester grades to curb mental health crisis, exploring the impact of grading policies on student well-being.
items.summary_zh: 密歇根大学为缓解心理健康危机而下调第一学期成绩，探讨评分政策对学生福祉的影响。文章分析在学术标准与学生支持之间的平衡问题。

items.title_en: Edge is dropping older extensions(Manifest V2), affecting popular privacy tools
items.title_zh: Edge 正在弃用较旧的扩展架构 Manifest V2，影响隐私工具
items.summary_en: Edge is dropping older Manifest V2 extensions, affecting popular privacy tools that rely on MV2 APIs. The transition pushes developers to migrate to Manifest V3, with trade-offs in extension capability and performance.
items.summary_zh: Edge 正在弃用较旧的 Manifest V2 扩展，影响依赖 MV2 API 的隐私工具。迁移至 Manifest V3 的过程中，扩展功能性与性能之间的取舍成为关键挑战。

items.title_en: DosTips, Windows scripting knowledge trove, scraped to death
items.title_zh: DosTips：Windows 脚本知识宝库被大规模抓取
items.summary_en: It highlights how such scraping impacts creators, site operators, and users who rely on trusted, curated resources.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 DosTips 的 Windows 脚本知识宝库被大规模抓取的问题，涉及许可、署名以及社区知识库的可持续性。事件凸显了内容创作者、站点运营方与依赖可信资源的用户之间的利害关系。

items.title_en: I built a browser-native SysEx librarian for 80s/90s synthesizers
items.title_zh: 浏览器原生的 SysEx 管理工具，用于80年代/90年代合成器
items.summary_en: I built a browser-native SysEx librarian for 80s/90s synthesizers, letting users manage, store, and load SysEx data directly in the browser. This showcases how modern web tech can support vintage hardware workflows without desktop software.
items.summary_zh: 我用浏览器原生技术实现了一个 SysEx 管理工具，用于整理和加载 80 年代/90 年代合成器的 SysEx 数据。无需桌面软件即可在浏览器中完成整理，展示了现代网页技术在音乐硬件工作流中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: Antiqua–Fraktur dispute
items.title_zh: Antiqua–Fraktur 之争
items.summary_en: The Antiqua–Fraktur dispute was a long-running debate over whether German texts should use Antiqua (Roman type) or Fraktur (blackletter). It shaped publishing, education, and national identity, culminating in shifts in official typography in the 20th century.
items.summary_zh: Antiqua–Fraktur 之争是关于德国文本应采用 Antiqua（罗马体）还是 Fraktur（黑体字）的长期文化辩论。它影响了印刷、教育与国家身份认同，直到20世纪的官方字体政策才发生转变。

items.title_en: Learning 10000 pictures (1973) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 学习一万张图片（1973）
items.summary_en: Standing's 1973 study shows humans can memorize and recognize thousands of images with high accuracy, offering enduring insights into memory and visual learning. The results continue to influence how we think about data-efficient perception and AI training.
items.summary_zh: Standing 等人在1973年的研究显示，人类能够记忆并辨认数以万计的图片，而且记忆保持相当稳固。这一发现对理解长期记忆和视觉学习的效率具有持续影响，也为大规模视觉数据的学习研究提供参考。

items.title_en: The hardest working font in Manhattan (2025)
items.title_zh: 曼哈顿最忙碌的字体（2025）
items.summary_en: The hardest working font in Manhattan (2025) examines a font optimized for dense urban signage, readability across distances and lighting, and high-contrast digital displays.
items.summary_zh: 《曼哈顿最忙碌的字体（2025）》聚焦一种为密集城市环境量身打造的字体，强调远近可读性、对比度和昼夜照明下的清晰呈现。文章探讨字体设计如何提升城市信息传达的效率与可访问性。

items.title_en: Felix and I
items.title_zh: Felix 与我
items.summary_en: A personal piece about collaboration and friendship with someone named Felix, exploring how partnerships shape creative work and problem solving. It emphasizes shared effort over solo genius.
items.summary_zh: 关于与名为 Felix 的人合作与友谊的个人文稿，探讨伙伴关系如何塑造创造力与解决问题的过程，强调共同努力的力量。

items.title_en: Mushroom behind 'tiny people' hallucinations identified
items.title_zh: 识别出引发小人幻觉的蘑菇
items.summary_en: Researchers have identified the mushroom species behind reports of tiny people hallucinations during certain psychedelic experiences. The finding sheds light on how specific compounds reshape visual perception, with implications for safety, medical research, and foragers' awareness.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员已确定在某些迷幻体验中引发小人幻觉的蘑菇种类。该发现揭示了特定成分如何改变视觉感知，为安全使用、药物研究和野外采集者的认知提高了理解。

items.title_en: The lattice of sets of natural numbers is rich (2021)
items.title_zh: 自然数集合的格结构极其丰富（2021）
items.summary_en: A math blog post explores the rich lattice structure of sets of natural numbers, shedding light on the depth of order-theoretic properties in a seemingly simple domain. It highlights how foundational combinatorics can reveal surprising complexity.
items.summary_zh: 数学博客探讨自然数集合的格结构的丰富性，揭示一个看似简单的领域也隐藏着深刻的序理论性质。文章强调基础组合学中可揭示的意想不到的复杂性。

items.title_en: Come for ENIAC, Stay for UNIVAC and Skeduflo
items.title_zh: 从 ENIAC 到 UNIVAC 与 Skeduflo 的计算机史
items.summary_en: A historical piece traces the arc from ENIAC to UNIVAC and Skeduflo, tying early computing milestones to modern tooling and educational perspectives. It offers a concise lens on how foundational machines influence today’s workflows.
items.summary_zh: 一篇历史文章梳理了从 ENIAC 到 UNIVAC 及 Skeduflo 的计算机史脉络，连接了早期计算里程碑与现代工具与教育视角。提供了一个简明的视角，展示早期机器如何影响今日的工作流。

items.title_en: High-Res Photo Shows Sand-Capped Butte Rising from Mars Plain of Polygons
items.title_zh: 火星 polygons 平原上沙帽小丘的高分辨率照片
items.summary_en: A high-resolution image from a Mars mission reveals a sand-capped butte rising from a polygonal plain, shedding light on geology and erosion processes on the Red Planet. The detail helps scientists study surface features and paleoenvironmental conditions.
items.summary_zh: 来自火星探测任务的高分辨率照片显示，风化的沙帽小丘在多边形地貌平原上耸立。此图像为研究火星地质与侵蚀过程提供细节，帮助科学家理解古环境条件。

items.title_en: Picking berries is my meditation
items.title_zh: 采摘浆果是我的冥想
items.summary_en: A reflective piece on how berry picking becomes a meditative practice, offering a counterbalance to fast-paced tech work. It highlights mindfulness as a valuable counterweight for focused, creative coding sessions.
items.summary_zh: 这篇反思文章讲述采摘浆果如何成为一种冥想练习，为快节奏的科技工作提供对照。强调正念在保持专注与创造性编程中的重要作用。

items.title_en: Better Gaussian Splatting in Julia
items.title_zh: 在 Julia 中实现更好的高斯喷溅法
items.summary_en: It highlights how language-specific optimizations can yield tangible gains in graphics and ML tooling.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍在 Julia 中改进高斯喷溅法，旨在提升渲染效果或点云可视化性能，展示语言层优化如何带来显著的图形与机器学习工具改进。

items.title_en: The Bit Player: My Father with Steve Zissou
items.title_zh: 小人物：我的父亲与 Steve Zissou
items.summary_en: A reflective essay blending memory, cinema, and fatherhood, using Steve Zissou as a metaphor for mentorship and influence. It weaves personal history with pop culture to explore imagination and legacy.
items.summary_zh: 一篇融合记忆、电影与父子的反思性散文，以 Steve Zissou 为隐喻探讨导师与影响力，讲述个人历史与流行文化如何塑造想象力与传承。

items.title_en: From rubber boots to Copa: When MicroProse Soccer revolutionized football
items.title_zh: 从橡胶靴到 Copa：MicroProse Soccer 如何革新足球
items.summary_en: MicroProse Soccer helped redefine football video games, introducing innovations that influenced later sports sims and the way players engage with virtual football. Its design choices echoed through the genre, shaping how fans interact with digital football.
items.summary_zh: MicroProse Soccer 在足球电子游戏史上具有里程碑意义，带来若干创新并影响后续体育游戏的设计与玩家体验。其在玩法、人工智能与授权方面的尝试成为后来作品的参照。

items.title_en: Debugging Information for Inlined Functions
items.title_zh: 内联函数的调试信息
items.summary_en: The article explains how debugging information for inlined functions is represented, and what information compilers emit to make sense of inlining. It covers techniques to preserve useful stack traces and variable scopes despite inlining, improving post-mortem debugging.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了内联函数在调试信息中的表示方式，以及编译器如何输出调试信息以便在优化后仍能追踪源代码。介绍了在内联导致栈帧和变量作用域变化时，调试工具应如何保持有用的调试信息。

items.title_en: The Three-Stroke Problem
items.title_zh: 三笔画问题
items.summary_en: A crisp discussion of a classic three-stroke rendering problem, framed around vector design tooling.
items.summary_zh: 三笔画问题是一则经典的绘制/排版难题，在 Penpot 的设计背景下被讨论。其核心涉及在有限笔画条件下实现稳定的形状与连贯性，对矢量设计工具有启发意义。

items.title_en: Locating an unknown source of radiation in a heterogeneous environment (2019)
items.title_zh: 在异质环境中定位未知辐射源（2019）
items.summary_en: A 2019 study tackles locating an unknown radiation source in a heterogeneous environment using inverse methods and signal processing. The approach has implications for nuclear safety, environmental monitoring, and geophysical sensing where material variability matters.
items.summary_zh: 2019 年的研究聚焦在异质介质环境中定位未知辐射源，使用反问题和信号处理方法。该方法对核安全、环境监测与地球物理探测具有现实意义，尤其在材料多样性显著的场景中。

items.title_en: What garbage collection actually costs
items.title_zh: 垃圾回收的真实成本
items.summary_en: A deep dive into what garbage collection actually costs beyond CPU cycles, including latency, pause times, and memory fragmentation. The piece argues for mindful runtime design and memory management strategies.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨垃圾回收超过 CPU 周期的真实成本，包括延迟、暂停时间和内存碎片等。文章主张在运行时设计与内存管理策略上要有意识地权衡。
